## Exercise 1 (Read the data)

```{r}
# Absolut sti til data, uanset system:
sti_pop <- here::here("world_population.csv")

# Indlæs data:
wpop_full <- readr::read_csv(
  file = sti_pop,
  skip = 4)

wpop_full <- wpop_full |>
  dplyr::rename(
    country = `Country Name`,
    code = `Country Code`
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(- c(`2023`, `Indicator Name`, `Indicator Code`))

#

```


## Exercise 2 (get iso-codes)

```{r}
wiki_url <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1"
iso_codes_all <- rvest::read_html(wiki_url) |>
  rvest::html_elements("table") |>
  rvest::html_table() |>
  purrr::pluck(3) |>
  dplyr::select(name = 1, iso3 = 3, independent = 6)
iso_codes_all
```




## Exercise 3 (iso codes from independent countries)

```{r}
iso_codes <- iso_codes_all |>
  dplyr::filter(independent == "Yes")
```


## Exercise 4

```{r}
wpop <- wpop_full |>
  dplyr::semi_join(iso_codes, by = c("code" = "iso3"))
```

## Exercise 5

```{r}
wpop |>
  dplyr::left_join(iso_codes, by = c("code" = "iso3")) |>
  dplyr::select(name, code, country) |>
  dplyr::filter(name != country)

```




## Exercise 6 (get continents)

```{r}
wiki_url <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_sovereign_states_and_dependent_territories_by_continent_(data_file)"
continents <- rvest::read_html(wiki_url) |>
  rvest::html_elements("table") |>
  rvest::html_table(convert = FALSE) |>
  purrr::pluck(3) |>
  dplyr::select(continent = 1, iso3 = 3)
continents
```



## Exercise 7

```{r}
wpop2 <- wpop |>
  dplyr::left_join(continents, by = dplyr::join_by(code == iso3)) |>
  dplyr::relocate(continent)
wpop2
```

## Exercise 8 (make pop_long)

```{r}
pop_long <- wpop2 |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::matches("[[:digit:]]{4}"), values_to = "pop",
    names_to = "year") |>
  dplyr::mutate(year = as.integer(year))

pop_long
```

## Exercise 9

```{r}
pop_long |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = year, y = pop, group = code)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Population")

```

## Exercise 10

```{r}
pop_index <- pop_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(country, continent, code) |>
  dplyr::mutate(pop_index = pop / pop[1])
```

## Exercise 11

```{r}
pop_index |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(x = year, y = pop_index, group = code)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Population index pr. country")
```


## Exercise 12

```{r}
pop_index |>
  dplyr::filter(!(code %in% c("ARE", "QAT"))) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = year, y = pop_index, group = code)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Population index pr. country")
```

## Exercise 13 FIX FIX

```{r}
growth_long <- pop_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(country, continent, code) |>
  dplyr::reframe(pop_start = pop[1:(length(pop) - 1)],
          pop_end = pop[2:length(pop)],
          growth = 100 * (pop_end - pop_start) / pop_start,
          end_year = year[2:length(year)])

growth_long
```

EXPLAIN


## Exercise 14

```{r}
growth_long |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = end_year, y = growth, group = code)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Year to year pop growth in pct")
```



## Exercise 15

```{r}
growth_long |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = end_year, y = growth, group = code)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ continent) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Year to year pop growth in pct")
```
## Exercise 16

```{r}
growth_range <- growth_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(country) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    max_growth = round(max(growth), 2),
    min_growth = round(min(growth), 2))

growth_range
```


## Exercise 17

```{r}
top10 <- growth_range |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(max_growth)) |>
  head(10)

top10
```

## Exercise 18

```{r}
bottom10 <- growth_range |>
  dplyr::arrange(min_growth) |>
  head(10)

bottom10
```
## Exercise 19

```{r}
growth_long |>
  dplyr::filter(country %in% top10$country) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = end_year, y = growth, color = country)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line()
```
